title: 3774. Absolute Difference Between Maximum and Minimum K Elements

examples.explanation: The k = 2 largest elements are 4 and 5. Their sum is 4 + 5 = 9. The k = 2 smallest elements are 2 and 2. Their sum is 2 + 2 = 4. The absolute difference is abs(9 - 4) = 5.
The largest element is 100. The smallest element is 100. The absolute difference is abs(100 - 100) = 0.
